items.question: What kind of work do you take on?
items.answer: Brand identity, packaging, motion and product visualisation — mostly for studios, founders, and teams who care about typography and craft.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Most identity and packaging projects run four to eight weeks depending on scope. You'll get a clear timeline before anything starts.

items.question: What do you need to get started?
items.answer: A short brief on your goals, audience, and timeline. If you don't have one yet, we'll shape it together on a first call.

items.question: Do you work with teams or solo founders?
items.answer: Both. I've worked embedded with product teams and one-to-one with founders — the process adapts either way.

items.question: What are your rates?
items.answer: Projects are quoted as a fixed fee based on scope, so the cost is clear up front. Retainers are available for ongoing work.

items.question: How do we start working together?
items.answer: Send a note through the contact form. I'll reply within a couple of days and we'll set up an intro call.
